data.name: Sound of Horses
data.detailed_description:
Sound of Horses is a story-driven horseback adventure that grows over time during Early Access.

Your journey begins in the peaceful Homeland and slowly leads into something deeper.

Create your own rider and horse, explore open landscapes filled with everyday life and quiet mysteries, and meet memorable characters who shape your journey.

What’s included in Episode 1

Episode 1 introduces the world of Sound of Horses and tells a complete opening chapter of the story, where everyday life on horseback gradually leads into the first unfolding mystery.

It offers approximately 6–7 hours of story-driven gameplay, with additional time for exploration depending on playstyle.

About the remaining episodes

The remaining episodes are currently planned to be released together as part of the full version, continuing the story and expanding the world.

Everyone who already owns the game will receive Episodes 2 to 4 at no additional cost.

The final price is currently planned to be around $24.99 USD.

The journey ahead

Starting with Episode 2: The Forest Guard, the story begins to cross over into the Other Side, a parallel world shaped by forgotten secrets and ancient forces.

From that point on, your journey will move between two worlds:

the familiar routines of Homeland, and the strange, shifting paths of what lies beyond.

Even as you’re drawn deeper into the unknown, life in Homeland continues, asking for your time, your choices, and your care.

Along the way, you’ll discover the unique horse cultures of each region, each with its own traditions, breeds, and competitions.

Planned story episodes

Episode 1 – Homeland

Begin your story in the quiet Homeland, where everyday life on horseback slowly gives way to something unexpected.


Episode 2 – The Forest Guard

Journey through deep forests and snow-covered mountains, uncovering the way of the Forest Guards and the secrets they protect.


Episode 3 – The Mystery of Draconia

Solve ancient riddles and take part in legendary competitions in a land shaped by old myths.


Episode 4 – The Land of the Eagle

Train with the people of the Steppe and face a final test of strength, trust, and skill against the legendary Eagle.

With a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and a meaningful riding experience, Sound of Horses invites players of all ages to step into a gentle but growing adventure.

Sound of Horses – Powered by Vanilla Technology
VANILLA SKY PRODUCTIONS

data.short_description: Sound of Horses is a story-driven horseback adventure. Begin your journey in the peaceful Homeland and uncover a world of hidden truths and distant echoes of something greater. Create your own rider and horse, explore an open world on horseback, and start your adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Athlon II (K10) 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660, Intel Iris Xe, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
